text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! What a hit, what a hit!
The ball sure flew far today!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: At this pace, first I'll practice with video games, and just like I saw on UmaTube, strike the ball as though slashing with a katana—
No Reason-san... What on earth was that just now?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: M-McQueen-dono?! No! I am not slacking off, you hear?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Y-You always say it yourself, Trainer!
'Just try whatever catches your interest!'
So this is all part of training too—!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A core so stable it never wavers—
And the muscular power to drive the ball that far—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: And... the explosive speed to decisively seize that single fleeting moment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: —And then! E-Even to an amateur like me, it was utterly mesmerizing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... "Just go ahead and do whatever interests you."
This is the fruit of that coaching philosophy, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: ...I got praised more than I expected...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha, I thought it was just an offhand remark.
She's pretty sharp, too.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Haha, I simply wanted to make sure I didn't miss a single word you said!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: I'll be counting on you today as well, Strategist.
